data.description:
## What
Run the trivial replay harness (tests/brainstorm/test-trivial-replay.sh) end-to-end and verify exit code 0. Fix any integration issues discovered during the run.

## Why
Story f629-4fa9 DD2: The done definition requires the harness to execute one trivial replay end-to-end with exit code 0 — it must actually run, not just exist structurally.

## Acceptance Criteria
- bash tests/brainstorm/test-trivial-replay.sh exits 0
- The run exercises the fixture and assertion helpers (not just a no-op pass)
- If the trivial replay requires a live LLM and cannot be run in CI, the test falls back to structural-only assertions with a documented skip condition (SKIP_LLM_REPLAY=1 env var guard)
- All pass/fail output is human-readable
- No other tests in tests/brainstorm/ or tests/skills/ regress

## Files to Modify
- tests/brainstorm/test-trivial-replay.sh (fix integration issues if any)
- tests/brainstorm/README.md (document skip condition if applicable)

## testing_mode
GREEN
